name: Card layout
says: Your screen or game sits as a card across the middle, your face in a circle above it, and the captions between them, so nothing covers the picture.
ask: Put the game in the middle and my face on top.

name: Stacked layout
says: Your face on top and the game or screen below it, for a stream where your reaction matters as much as the game.
ask: Show my face on top and the game below it.

name: Full face
says: Your face fills the whole frame, for a story or a sit-down talk.
ask: Make it just me talking, full screen.

name: Follow the subject
says: One part of the picture fills the frame, such as the product in your hand or the action.
ask: Keep the product in the middle of the frame.

name: Trim or take in more
says: Start the clip earlier or later, end it sooner or after the laugh. Tap Trim under the clip, or just say it: the layout stays, and the captions and effects stay on what is said and shown.
ask: Start 3 seconds earlier and cut the last bit.

name: Move a part
says: Puts the face circle, the card or another part exactly where you want it, and says what a phone would cover there.
ask: Move my face circle to the bottom right.

name: Clean words
says: Clear white letters with a thin dark outline that read on any picture.
ask: Use simple, clean text.

name: Bold pop words
says: Bold letters with a black outline and a shadow that stand out on busy game footage.
ask: Make the words bold so they pop on the game.

name: Sticker words
says: Dark letters on a white box, like a sticker on the clip.
ask: Put the words on white boxes like stickers.

name: Glowing script
says: Handwritten-style letters with a warm orange glow, for the one word that matters.
ask: Make the title glow.

name: 3D words
says: Heavy white letters with a deep orange edge and shadow, so they look raised off the clip.
ask: Make the title look 3D.

name: Classic italic
says: Elegant serif italic letters for short, calm words.
ask: Use an elegant italic font for the title.

name: Your font and colours
says: A font from the studio or from your computer, and your own colours; a colour that would be hard to read gets an outline that makes it readable.
ask: Use Kanit for the captions and make the title yellow.

name: Title on screen
says: Puts your words on screen for as long as you say, measured as they will be drawn, never over a face or where a phone covers the clip.
ask: Put 'Boss down' at the top for the first 3 seconds.

name: Words behind you
says: The title passes behind your head and body, so you stand in front of the words, and enough of them stays readable.
ask: Put the title behind me.

name: Plain captions
says: Captions of what was said, a few words a line, with every number exactly as said, so the eye stays on the picture.
ask: Add captions.

name: Lit-up captions
says: Each word lights up in colour at the moment it is said, like karaoke.
ask: Make each word light up as I say it.

name: Pop-in captions
says: Each word pops in at its place as it is said and stays, so the line builds up with the speech.
ask: Make the captions pop in word by word.

name: White flash
says: A short white flash on the moment something lands.
ask: Flash the screen when the boss goes down.

name: Screen shake
says: The picture shakes for a moment and settles, like an impact.
ask: Shake the screen on the hit.

name: Quick punch-in
says: A quick zoom in and back out, to punch a reaction.
ask: Zoom in fast on my reaction.

name: Big word
says: A big word such as POW pops in on the moment, grows past its size and settles, then fades.
ask: Put a big WOW when I win.

name: Slow push in
says: The picture moves slowly closer, like a camera pushing in, for the build-up before the peak.
ask: Slowly zoom in before the big moment.

name: Emoji sticker
says: A 3D emoji pops in, holds and fades out, such as fire on the peak or a money bag on a price.
ask: Add a fire emoji when I win.

name: Sticker burst
says: A handful of stickers fly out from one spot every way, spinning, then drop a little and fade, like money thrown in the air.
ask: Make money burst out when I get paid.

name: Sticker rain
says: Stickers fall from the top one after another, swaying, such as coins raining down on a win.
ask: Make coins rain down when I win.

name: Sticker fountain
says: Stickers shoot up from the bottom and fall back, one after another, like a fountain.
ask: Shoot gems up like a fountain on the big moment.

name: Bouncing stickers
says: Stickers drop from the top, bounce twice on the bottom and stay there.
ask: Drop coins that bounce at the end.

name: Rising hearts
says: Stickers float up from the bottom to the top, swaying, like balloons or hearts.
ask: Float hearts up when I say thank you.

name: Scattered stickers
says: Stickers pop up one by one all over a box, stay a moment, then fade together.
ask: Pop fire and stars all around the title.

name: Party popper
says: Confetti and stickers shoot up from both bottom corners like a party popper, then drift down.
ask: Pop confetti when the clip ends.

name: Frosted glass box
says: A rounded frosted-glass panel, light or dark, for a title, a price or a list to stand on so the words read over a busy picture.
ask: Put the price on a glass box.

name: Vivid colour
says: More contrast and richer greens and blues, with skin and reds kept as they are: for games and flat footage.
ask: Make the colours more vivid.

name: Warm colour
says: Warmer middle tones with black and white kept, so a white product stays white: for faces, food and products.
ask: Make it look warmer.

name: Soft film look
says: Soft blacks and whites and calmer colour, for a quiet, calm clip.
ask: Give it a soft film look.

name: Black and white world
says: The footage around you turns black and white while you keep your colour; Meta's SAM 3.1 finds you frame by frame on this computer.
ask: Make everything black and white except me for the last 5 seconds.

name: Outline around you
says: A white edge follows your outline as you move, found by SAM 3.1 on this computer.
ask: Put a white outline around me when I laugh.

name: Hit sounds
says: A short sound on a moment: a deep thump, a whoosh, a pop or a small ding, used only on the hits that matter.
ask: Add a whoosh on the flash.

name: Your music
says: Your own music under the clip; it goes down while someone speaks, loops if short, and fades in and out.
ask: Put my song under the clip, quietly.

name: Mute a part
says: Pick the seconds and the sound there goes: a count-in, someone else talking, a noise. The picture and your music play on, and the captions leave out those words.
ask: Mute the sound from 0 to 3 s.

name: Blur a box
says: Blurs one part of the picture so nothing in it can be read, such as the chat with viewers' names or a phone number.
ask: Blur the chat box.

name: Find your videos
says: Lists the recordings on this computer, newest first, and finds one by a word in its name, folder or day.
ask: Find the stream I recorded on Monday.

name: Open a long video
says: Opens one recording, such as a two-hour stream or a selling live, and reads its length, picture and sound.
ask: Open my newest stream.

name: Knows the kind of video
says: Muse picks the way to cut it for the kind of video it is: a tutorial, a game stream, a talk, a product review or trip clips. Its guesses show as buttons, so you change one with a tap.
ask: This is a product review.

name: Map the whole video
says: Measures every second of a long recording for loud moments and picture changes, so Muse knows where to look first. About half a minute for each hour of video, and only once.
ask: Find the best moments in this two-hour stream.

name: Watch and listen
says: Muse looks at pictures from a stretch and reads what is said there before it chooses.
ask: Look around 1:20:00, where I won the round.

name: Suggest moments
says: Shows the best moments as cards, each with Muse's reason, a picture, what is said and a rough video. Tap another card to make that one instead.
ask: Show me the funniest moments.

name: A plan you can see
says: For a bigger request Muse writes a short plan first and ticks each step as it works through it.
ask: Make three clips with English subtitles.

name: Undo
says: Takes the last change to the clip back. The Undo button under the clip does the same.
ask: Undo that.

name: Many clips at once
says: Makes a clip from each moment in one go, each with its captions, title, post text and checks, and says which are ready and why any is not.
ask: Make a clip of every product I sold.

name: Clips from a folder
says: Opens every short video in one folder, such as a day out shot on your phone, to make one clip from them.
ask: Make one clip from my Japan folder.

name: Tell it as a story
says: Puts the short videos in the order that tells the story best, keeps the best seconds of each, says why, and says why any was left out.
ask: Put my trip videos in a good order.

name: Who is on screen
says: In a talk between people, shows one person or everyone for a stretch, such as when someone reacts.
ask: Show her face when she laughs.

name: Fonts that fit
says: Lists the fonts that can write every letter of your words, Thai included, and whether each is free to use in a video you post.
ask: Which fonts can write Thai?

name: Take a title off
says: Takes a title off the clip by its words.
ask: Take the title off.

name: Find someone in the clip
says: Shows the clip with a number on every face, so you can say who to blur by where they stand.
ask: Blur the man in white at 12 seconds.

name: Blur or keep people
says: You decide who is blurred and who is kept; a blurred face is followed as it moves. A clip with someone not yet decided is not made into a video.
ask: Blur the people behind me.

name: Make the video
says: Makes the finished vertical video, 1080 by 1920, on your computer.
ask: Make the video.

name: Checks the facts
says: Checks the finished video for what a program can prove: captions are words that were said, numbers on screen were said, no viewer's name or private line can be read, it does not start black or silent, and it fits a Reel. The program checks facts; you keep the taste.
ask: Check the clip before I post it.

name: Ready to post
says: Gives you the video with a title, post text and hashtags, a Copy all button and a download.
ask: Write the post text for Instagram Reels.

name: Your channel's look
says: Keeps this clip's text style, colour, captions, title spot and your channel's name, so every new clip starts in it. Save it under Channel beside the clip, or ask Muse.
ask: Save this look for my channel Siney Society.

name: Switch channel
says: Puts one of your saved channel looks on the clip, or none.
ask: Use my Siney Society look.
